visualCharacteristics: Flush, rule-separated accordion of product specification groups (multi-open, collapsed initially) with an Expand All / Collapse All text button above; each body is a two-column label/value list (bold label, value).
contentPattern: One item per spec group: summary = group title, text = list items (or paragraphs) of the form Label value. Items without a bold label render as full-width text rows. The Expand All / Collapse All button is generated by the block; labels come from placeholders expand-all / collapse-all (default: Expand All / Collapse All).

usage.description: Product specification groups on product driver/support pages.

reuseGuidance: Use for label/value specification data grouped into collapsible sections. Use the table block when the data must stay visible or has more than two columns.
